observation.visible_scene: A high-speed view against a blurred, dark forest background shows a roughly spherical puff of pale powder/smoke suspended on the right side of the frame, held by a thin black rod entering from the right edge. A small fixed red marker dot sits on the rod/holder at the right of the cloud. Inside the cloud a projectile (a small bullet-shaped object) is present, and an orange-red glowing region develops within the powder.
visible_changes: An orange-red ignition front first appears as a thin crescent on the left side of the powder cloud (around t=0.08 s) and progressively thickens into a bright vertical flame column (yellow-orange core) that persists through the rest of the segment.
The pale powder cloud expands and diffuses outward over time, becoming larger and more wispy while remaining centered near its original position on the right.

A bullet-shaped object, initially embedded in the cloud, moves steadily leftward across the frames, emerging from the cloud and traveling into the open background on the left by the end of the segment.
The small red dot on the holder at the right of the cloud stays in essentially the same position throughout, distinguishing it from the moving projectile.
The blurred forest background shows no clear relative shift, consistent with a fixed camera; the apparent motion is of the projectile and the cloud, not the viewpoint.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause/trigger of the ignition and the origin of the projectile are not shown.
Whether the glow is combustion of the powder, a muzzle flash, or both is not determinable from the frames.
The projectile's trajectory before entering the cloud and its fate after leaving the segment are unseen.
The full lifetime of the cloud (formation and final dissipation) lies outside the cropped window.
uncertain_details: Exact material identity of the cloud and the projectile.
Precise timing of ignition onset relative to projectile passage (the segment begins with the process already underway).
Any minor camera drift cannot be fully excluded given the uniformly blurred background.
